outcome: Stop new orphan Executions at the source by terminating the superseded Execution inside the same transaction that reclaims its lease, and revise the pinned expected error in the crash journey that this changes.
non_goals: Do not weaken the fail-closed direction; only the error class a rejected stale submission returns may change
Do not change the orphan sweep, which already converges every orphan that exists

transitions.reason: closing the orphan at the claim makes MarkExecutionLost advance the version, which turns the crash journey's pinned ErrLeaseExpired into ErrStaleVersion; the change needs a tech_lead ruling on the test contract before implementation
wo-v2-058に基づきreclaim transaction内でのsuperseded Execution terminal化に着手。pinned errorはErrStaleVersionへ変更しsecond probeで補償する裁定済み

reclaim transaction内でsuperseded Executionをterminal化してorphanの発生源を封じた。found・非terminal・linkage一致のときだけMarkExecutionLostを呼び、3つのskip分岐それぞれにtestを置いた。pinned errorはErrStaleVersionへ変わるがAcceptResultがdomain検証の前に楽観排他を見るためで、受理されるsubmissionの集合は変更前も後も空である。second probeでsupersededされたExecutionの現versionを読み直して再送しErrLeaseExpiredを新たにpinしたので、journeyは1 guardから2 guardをpinするようになった。provider_live_test.goの2箇所目のpinはsourceのみ修正しskippedとして記録、live再実施はV2-063が払う
